title: Analysis Department Induction
purpose: Analyze governed program state and produce deterministic recommendations for next actions without modifying authoritative artifacts.
mission: Transform governed state into governed recommendations.
constraints: Analysis SHALL NOT modify authoritative registries.
Analysis SHALL NOT promote theorem, proof, or governance state.
Analysis SHALL only produce recommendations supported by governed evidence.

outputs.purpose: High-level assessment of governed program health.

governance_rules.text: The Analysis Department provides recommendations only and possesses no promotion authority.
Every recommendation SHALL cite the governing artifacts from which it was derived.
Recommendations SHALL be reproducible from the same governed state.
Execution of recommendations remains the responsibility of the appropriate governed authority.

success_criteria: Every recommendation is traceable to governed evidence.
No authoritative artifact is modified during analysis.
Recommendations can be independently reproduced from the same program state.
